integrity: All stationary moment identities use an exact polynomial generator recurrence with independent numerical linear-system checks. Zero kurtosis does not mean a Gaussian distribution.
scientific_limitations: Exact no-thermal-noise one-dimensional symmetric-telegraph oscillator; stationary fourth cumulant only. No finite-sample estimates or arbitrary forcing laws. The generic dichotomous-noise filter result of Pawula (1987) was accessible only by abstract and leaves a publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp sign phase diagram for stationary position kurtosis of a trapped inertial run-and-tumble particle
